title: Wildsea Tools
description: Useful tools for running the Wildsea TTRPG, served through GitHub Pages.

tools.name: Journey Dashboard
tools.description: Run a leg of the journey from one screen: watch results, weather, a point of interest, and a hazard, with each panel re-rollable on its own.

tools.name: Ship Generator
tools.description: Generate a random NPC ship using options from the Wildsea Core Rules shipbuilding section.

tools.name: Watch Results
tools.description: Roll watch results for the crewmember on watch, using the core table or any of the six Reaches' own tables.

tools.name: Weather Conditions
tools.description: Roll weather-watching results to shift the skies for the next leg of a journey.

tools.name: Points of Interest
tools.description: Generate a place to drop onto a spit, tallshank, or island, with a site, sensory detail, hook, and sample resources.

tools.name: Hazards
tools.description: Draw a hazard from the eight core categories and get a ready-to-run encounter track sized to it. Leviathans are opt-in; forces of nature arrive as backdrop conditions.
